note: Standalone dated registry (data/sources.json is frozen and untouched). Records the only resources acquired by Stage64 and the bounded search for an official notional-results publication.

sources.organisation: The Tally Room (Ben Raue), third party
sources.dateOrElection: Notional 2023 New Zealand general election results on the 2025 final boundaries; post written 2025-10-03
sources.resource: Public Google Sheet linked from the article below, exported as CSV (72 rows: 71 new seats plus the abolished Ōhāriu)
limitations: Not an official publication. Method and inputs are not disclosed on the page; estimates of first and second candidate and party votes per new seat.

Party percentages agree with official 2023 shares at the 17 certified-exact seats only up to a denominator effect (probably ordinary votes only); log ratios of two parties agree to rounding there, so the comparison uses log ratios, not shares.
Used solely as an independent cross-check of the repo's own notional party-vote baseline. Never read by any model or forecast stage.
sources.licence: No licence stated on the sheet or article; a 12 KB comparison file is retained for provenance and can be removed if the author objects.

sources.organisation: The Tally Room (Ben Raue), third party
sources.resource: Article "New Zealand's new electoral map" (HTML as served; describes the four partisan changes, the 45/16/6/2/2 notional seat split and links the sheet)
limitations: Narrative only; read by hand to confirm the sheet's headline counts (docs/stage64-electorate-baseline-audit.md).
Discussion comments on the page are not evidence.
sources.licence: No licence stated; retained for provenance only.

boundedSearchForOfficialNotionalResults.question: Do the Electoral Commission or the Representation Commission publish official notional 2023 results on the 2025 final boundaries?
searches: web search: notional 2023 election results new 2025 electorate boundaries New Zealand
web search: Electoral Commission notional 2023 general election results 2026 boundaries
fetch: elections.nz boundary review 2025 page (returned an Incapsula bot-protection page, as in Stage40)
fetch: Wikipedia 2026 general election, 2023 results and electorate pages (no notional results)
boundedSearchForOfficialNotionalResults.outcome: Not found. No official notional results publication was located; the Representation Commission's Schedules B and C already preserved in the repo give boundaries and populations only. Absence is not proved because the Electoral Commission site could not be read directly. Third-party notionals exist (the Tally Room sheet above; Kiwiblog and The Progress Report publish projected or paywalled margins that are a different quantity and were not acquired).
boundedSearchForOfficialNotionalResults.furtherSearchPolicy: No second pass: an official table could change nothing in this stage unless it contradicted the repo's population-weighted baseline, and the Tally Room cross-check already bounds that.
